0022600092.text: The Trail Blazers host the Phoenix Suns in the first game of both teams' 2026-27 seasons, as neither team has played yet. In the 2025-26 season series, Portland lost 1-2, but the Trail Blazers won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026. Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Micah Potter is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery).
